purpose: A bounded cloud-agent candidate bank for spending Jules inference on independently reviewable SpaceFace tests, audits, fixes, polish, tooling, and small production slices. It is not the program queue and grants no admission, ownership, completion, or acceptance.

modelStrategy.gemini-3.6-flash: Use for narrow tests, bounded bug reproduction, data validation, lifecycle checks, surgical owner-level fixes, and deterministic tooling work.
modelStrategy.gemini-3.1-pro: Use for cross-system traces, measured structural optimization, visual/UX judgment, AI tuning, mission/content work, and other tasks where larger-context synthesis is load-bearing.

readBeforeMutation: Run git status --short and inspect current branch/HEAD.
Read build_map.md, AGENTS.md, every task readFirst file, and the nearest scoped AGENTS.md files.
Confirm live backend/owner selection in current code; prose and task paths are starting points, not authority over the working tree.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not create a second queue, acceptance system, roadmap, ledger, or orchestration framework.
Do not edit legacy flight/AI code for default gameplay without proving the selected live route owns the defect.
Do not lower default resolution, DPR, draw distance, asset fidelity, population, particles, bloom, shadows, post-processing, or simulation quality.
Do not add a dependency, rewrite a subsystem, reformat broad files, or perform unrelated cleanup unless the task explicitly requires it.
Do not rerun an unchanged failing command against the same candidate/environment.
Do not create an empty commit or PR when the honest result is NO_CHANGE.
Do not claim visual acceptance from source/DOM assertions alone or authored acceptance from a procedural fallback.

lanes.label: UI, UX, input reachability, and accessibility

lanes.label: Flight, combat, AI, and game feel
lanes.description: Strengthen live V3 flight and tactical AI through bounded invariants, readable telegraphs, and focused gameplay scenarios.

lanes.label: World, economy, missions, mining, and progression

lanes.label: Rendering, assets, VFX, camera, and audio

lanes.label: Tooling, data integrity, diagnostics, and documentation drift
lanes.description: Make the repository easier to trust and operate by reducing false greens, false reds, and stale routing knowledge.
